capabilities.statement: Generate a deterministic multi-file candidate bundle from a validated specification
Produce byte-equivalent repeated builds for identical approved inputs
Evaluate a static adapter contract without invoking an external provider
Generate and test a provider-free scaffold before any runtime integration

limitations: Natural-language runtime behavior has not been evaluated
Production approval has not been granted
The pattern required significant first-time engineering
Source compatibility must be re-verified before implementation reuse

tests.statement: Run the generator twice with identical approved inputs and compare every emitted byte
Validate the candidate bundle contains the expected manifest-governed file set
Execute scaffold tests without provider credentials or external actions
